edits.old: Then the delivery address of the recipient is resolved by the ACE notification path and is not stored in rwb_comms
edits.new:
Then the delivery address of the recipient is resolved by the ACE notification path and is not stored in rwb_comms

  Scenario: AC8 A second notice for the same approval and escalation level is refused by the unique key (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the notice of AC1 exists for approval "A-2" at escalation level 1
    When a second notice row is written for approval "A-2" at escalation level 1 with its own message
    Then the unique key of the notice kind, the approval reference and the escalation level refuses the second row
    Then no second message is handed to the ACE notification path and no outbox row is added

  Scenario: AC9 The message text comes from the template and carries the message ID MSG-P7-011 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the template of the escalation notice is Approved and current and carries the message ID "MSG-P7-011"
    When rwb-decision publishes ApprovalRequested for "A-2" at escalation level 1 on 15 December 2026
    Then the merged message is the template's wording with "{decision}" = "D7.1" and "{caseNo}" = "RW-2026-000123"
    Then no wording of the message is held in the code of rwb_comms

  Scenario: AC10 The channel is read from the template and the send goes through the ACE notification path (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the template of the escalation notice holds a channel value of LOV-CHANNEL on its template row
    When rwb-decision publishes ApprovalRequested for "A-2" at escalation level 1 on 15 December 2026
    Then the notice carries the channel held on the template row
    Then the send goes through the ACE notification path and no channel, template code or notice state is written in code

  Scenario: AC11 The notice is held in rwb_comms and this service reads no other service's table (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the notice of AC1 exists
    When the rows and the queries of this story are inspected
    Then the notice and its send facts are rows of rwb_comms only
    Then no query reads an `approval` row or a `delegation_limit` row of another service

  Scenario: AC12 The notice, the trail and the logs carry role codes, user references, case number, decision code and dates only (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the notice of AC1 and its decision record and log entries
    When the notice, the template merge values, the events, the trail and the logs of this story are inspected
    Then they carry role codes, user references, the case number, the decision code and dates only
    Then the delivery address of the recipient is the ACE notification path's and is not written by this story

  Scenario: AC13 A notice whose send fails keeps sent_at empty until the outbox retry succeeds (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the ACE notification path returns "unavailable" for the first send of the notice of AC1
    When rwb-decision publishes ApprovalRequested for "A-2" at escalation level 1 and the send fails
    Then the notice is kept with sent_at empty and its outbox retry is pending
    When the outbox retry succeeds
    Then the send happens once and sent_at is set once

  Scenario: AC14 The notice read answers 401, 403 and 404 for the refused callers (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-access contract mock returns the authorise answer refusing the caller to read the notice
    When a caller with no authentication sends GET /api/recovery/comms/v1/notices/{noticeId} for the notice of AC1
    Then the response is status 401
    When an authorised caller without the Litigation right sends GET /api/recovery/comms/v1/notices/{noticeId} for the notice of AC1
    Then the response is status 403 with MSG-P4-002
    When an authorised caller sends GET /api/recovery/comms/v1/notices/{noticeId} for a notice out of scope
    Then the response is status 404 with MSG-P4-003

  Scenario: AC15 A replayed write with the same idempotency key returns the existing notice (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the notice of AC1 exists for approval "A-2" at escalation level 1
    When the notice write for approval "A-2" at escalation level 1 is replayed with the same idempotency key, being the approval reference and escalation level of BR13
    Then the existing notice is returned and no second notice row, decision record or outbox row is written
    Then no second message is handed to the ACE notification path

  Scenario: AC16 A redelivered consumed event is acknowledged and processed once (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the ApprovalRequested fact for "A-2" at escalation level 1 has been consumed and the notice of AC1 exists
    When the same event is redelivered from rwb.decision.events.v1
    Then the redelivery is acknowledged and no second notice, decision record or outbox row is written
    Then no second message is handed to the ACE notification path

  Scenario: AC17 A status change the model does not allow is refused and produces no notice (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-decision contract mock refuses a status change for approval "A-2" that the model does not allow
    When rwb-decision refuses the status change for "A-2" on 15 December 2026
    Then no notice is written and nothing is handed to the ACE notification path
    Then no approval, no task and no case status changes in this story
